name: agentplatform
description: Local agent platform prototype for Codex task orchestration.

scripts.phase1-4:prepare: vitest run tests/manual/phase1-4-runtime-certification.test.ts -t "prepares a fresh zero-quota canary directory"
scripts.phase1-4:execute: vitest run tests/manual/phase1-4-runtime-certification.test.ts -t "executes exactly the already-prepared single canary"
scripts.phase1-4:isolation: vitest run tests/manual/phase1-4-runtime-isolation.test.ts -t "runs only from a qualifying immutable canary"
scripts.phase1-4:certification: vitest run tests/manual/phase1-4-runtime-isolation.test.ts -t "certification track remains candidate gated"
scripts.phase1-6:prepare: vitest run tests/manual/phase1-6-preparation.test.ts -t "prepares the immutable ten-case registration"
scripts.phase1-6:execute: vitest run tests/manual/phase1-6-real-execution.test.ts -t "executes only the sealed ten-case registration"
scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && electron-vite build
